title: Patch: a Flickered card starts its printed Brittle again, and a Keymaster Keenus or Shockwave447 made by a Transform draws its Aura's keywords
notes: R441: a Flicker re-enters the field, so zones::flicker_in_place now starts a printed Brittle afresh when the crumble spent its count, and restarts a held count's turn cycle, as every arrival from off the field does (zones::place_with); a Brittle Unit Radiant C #14 Shadowstep saves keeps its Brittle. An engine rule, so a replay it changes is refused as rules_changed (R767000). R4991000: a Keymaster Keenus (M #65) or Shockwave447 (S #111) a Transform makes on the field draws its Aura's keywords as it arrives (query::self_arrived_on_field), with no Cry; a Transform in a hand or a library draws nothing. Each card's script_before_transform_draw keeps the draw on summoned alone, keyed by this fragment, so replays of every version before this one fold under it (R4779000). classify stage 2 against main's build (a6a0c4ae99) finds M #65 and S #111 play differently, and M #24 Polymorph: the Aura now listens to transformed, so a Transform while one stands on the field queues its entry, which draws nothing but takes a number from nextSeq (one of the 200 unforced games, seed 89).

player.title: Saved Brittle Units crumble again, and transformed Auras draw
fixes: A Brittle Unit that Radiant Shadowstep saves counts its Brittle down again.
A Keymaster Keenus or Shockwave447 that a Transform makes gets its random keywords.
